services.name: wildlife in central pa
services.desc: If you love being surrounded by nature, you’re in for a treat at Glendale Valley Campground. Tucked away in the scenic heart of Central Pennsylvania, our campground is more than just a peaceful place to unplug, it’s also a fantastic spot for wildlife watching. There’s a good chance you’ll cross paths (or at least catch a glimpse) of some of the area’s most iconic animals during your stay.
